neighbours.label: the slot just before an upcoming gerund of deliberate constructive or analytical work in a coordination or list ('revising and [re]-structuring', 'designing [and] implementing', newline between gerund-headed list items); not before bodily or passive -ing verbs
fire: Her job involves planning, drafting and re-designing the layout of each exhibit.
The seminar is about building and evaluating statistical models for small samples.
They spent months collecting, cleaning and re-analysing the survey data.
Use this guide when you are self-reviewing your code before a merge.

Formulating a testable hypothesis
Designing the experiment
Interpreting the results

Defining the scope of the project
Mapping the existing workflow
Drafting a new plan

notes: Card: peaks on ' and', newline, ' re', ' self' before Applying/reorganising/re-writing/self-editing; output promotes ' developing', ' mapping', ' crafting', ' testing' and suppresses ' wearing', ' eating', ' falling'. Probes: 'revising and re' 0.77, gerund list newline 0.76, 'are self' 0.58, 'designing and' 0.49; 'stealing and wearing' 0.006. 'is currently' fired 0.28 before both 'developing' and 'eating' (same prefix), so that frame is left out. The - pole looks like the other side: the slot before a gerund of bodily/harmful action.
